text: The system shall authenticate a field engineer using credentials.
The system shall present to an authenticated field engineer the list of sites assigned to them.
The system shall allow an engineer to create an inspection report for a site by completing a checklist and attaching site photos.
The system shall enable an engineer to save an inspection report as a draft on the device.
The system shall allow an engineer to complete a saved draft and submit the final report at a later time.
The system shall process submitted report photos into thumbnail images.
The system shall generate a PDF summary of a submitted inspection report.
The system shall allow a site manager to browse inspection reports filtered by site and date.
The system shall enable a site manager to view photos associated with a selected inspection report.
The system shall permit a site manager to download the PDF summary of a selected inspection report.
The system shall allow a site manager to mark an inspection report as requiring follow‑up.
The system shall present follow‑up requests to an engineer upon their next sign‑in.
The system shall enable an administrator to create, modify, and deactivate engineer user accounts.
The system shall enable an administrator to assign and reassign engineers to sites.
The system shall back up the day's inspection reports and associated photos.
The backup shall be performed each night.
The system shall retain inspection records for a period of five years.
The retained inspection records shall remain intact and accessible after any redeployment or replacement of the service.
The browsing of a site’s report list shall respond within 3 seconds.
Photo processing failures shall not prevent engineers from submitting new inspection reports.
